notes.title: Traditional Chinese Language Pack Update
notes.notes: The Weird Dream has now been updated in Traditional Chinese, and more discounts and promotions are about to open

notes.title: April 30th Update
notes.notes:
1. Remake the portraits of four main characters
2. Players can now hold Num0(keyboard) or Select(controller) to reset an ongoing mirror boss challenge

notes.title: March 22nd Update
notes.notes:
Fixed game freeze under certain system languages.
Fixed summons not attacking monsters properly.
Reduced chasing tentacle’s speed during Yog boss fight.
Fixed some localization issues.
Fixed defeating Midi/Nadia/Xi before receiving corresponding mission would block players from completing them.
Fixed corridor fish boss would stuck under rare circumstances.
Increased max zoom for minimap.

notes.title: March 13th Update
notes.notes:
Fixed some spelling errors
Fixed tutorials not going away
Fixed repeated loading gamesave would cause cannon rune bonus damage to stack
We are currently working on the joystick recognition issue. If you encounter this problem, please try the following methods:
1. Connect your joystick AFTER the game is launched
2. Disable the steam controller manager if you have no use of it

notes.title: March 11th Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed players quit to main menu then reload the game would unable to unlock achievements.
[*] Added achievements detection function: previous achievements which didn’t unlock properly will now unlock upon loading your savefile.
[*] Disabled warp during Nebula escape sequence.
[*] For players who warped out during Nebula escape sequence, revisit the boss arena to restart the escape sequence.
[*] Fixed Corridor’s waterfall sfx glitch after defeating the fish boss.
[*] Adjusted speed of the tentacles during Yog’s escape sequence.
[*] Fixed the tutorial text for Dash won’t go away.
[*] Fixed using ultimate during Domino boss fight sometimes misplace game camera.
[*] Fixed Nebula eye boss sometimes won’t trigger.
[*] Fixed bats in campus can sometimes go through walls.
[*] Fixed screen shake too strong in certain areas.
[/list]

notes.title: March 10th Update
notes.notes:
1、Fixed a bug wcaused the game to freeze in Nebula Abyss
2、Improved game stability so that main character animation will not be stuck in game.
